summary: Keep suspended seats stopped when an owned set publishes a manual pending launch change.

replay.detail: Existing suspension and owned-set records are read without replay.

schema.detail: No claim schema or database migration changes.

rules.detail: Claim admission and actor authority are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Manual pending publication preserves an existing or in-flight suspension. Same-host resume runs the incumbent declaration and leaves the new declaration pending. Immediate non-manual launch changes still end suspension.

manual.detail: Explicit rollout refuses with rollout-suspended while suspension holds the seat. Resume the seat first, then request rollout to apply the pending declaration through strict native resume.

recovery.detail: Manual pending publication does not launch a suspended seat or discard its saved native session. Resume retains exact native-session verification.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon upgrade restart; interruption duration has not been measured.
